I've been playing Counter-Strike for many years, and CS:GO will always be my favorite game of all time. Across multiple Steam accounts, I've probably accumulated around 8,000 hours or more in CS:GO and another 2,000 hours in CS2. Since CS2 has replaced CS:GO, it's naturally become one of my most-played and favorite games.

That being said, I'm disappointed to say that I still think CS:GO felt much better overall. There's just something missing from CS2. In my opinion, the subtick system is a failure and often feels worse than what we had before. I also believe removing the in-game community server browser was a terrible decision.

That's not to say CS2 doesn't have its redeeming qualities, because it certainly does. I love the new smoke mechanics, and I appreciate how much more consistent grenade jump throws are without the need for binds, especially for newer players. The menus look much better and are easier to navigate, the game obviously looks and sounds better, and there are plenty of new settings that are much easier to access without having to use the console.

I don't think people should stop downloading or giving CS2 a chance. You can be sure I'll always keep coming back to it. Every time I launch the game and play a few matches, I have a great time. However, I can't help but feel that the game that replaced CS:GO, my favorite game of all time, should play and feel a little better than it currently does.

That's why I'm leaving a negative review. Not because I want to turn people away from the game, but because I genuinely believe the developers can do better, and they've shown in the past that they're capable of it.

For a while now, my team and I have been playing this game from computers at a gaming lounge. This means none of us can or would ever cheat—first, because we completely disagree with these methods, and second, because the lounge is strictly regulated by rules and terms where cheating results in heavy financial penalties and other serious consequences.
Despite all of this, the game banned us under the accusation of cheating, even though we are completely incapable of it and have never cheated. We play inside a controlled environment that follows strict regulations.
The most frustrating part is that actual cheaters are still playing normally, while innocent players who never cheat get banned. I honestly don't understand how paying customers who play fairly are treated this way.
Because of this, we have decided to stop playing this game entirely.
